note: Evil Mode slice 13, 'a neighbour' (design Part 15a sections 1 to 7; build plan Part 31 slice 13). Kanto's neighbour, Giovanni and Team Rocket: the seven stances, five ticks on fixed days, his messages, the Sit-Down, the Chair, the Betrayal and the Legend, and what's left of a team that falls. All text is from Part 15a. Numbers are starting values; none are playtested. 'on': false is the undo: the neighbour's holdings are nobody's.

basket.text: A fruit basket. A card: "Welcome to Kanto. — G." The fruit's excellent. There's a business card under the pears.
said: Nothing. The Mess has pears for three days. They're the best anyone's had. "They would be."
Sent back. Opinion: down a step. "Wasteful."
Sent one in return. Opinion: up a step. It goes back and forth all region. Nobody mentions it at any Sit-Down.
There's nothing in it. No wire, no note, no trick. "It's a fruit basket. That's worse, somehow."
basket.war: Another fruit basket, at War, as he said. The card: "— G."
basket.chair: The last basket. The card says "Well done. — G." There's no business card under the pears.

rules.broken: You leaned on {holding} on my side of the river. It was untidy. {who}'s mother's ill.

rules.rule: Pay your people on the day
rules.broken: You missed a Friday. I heard from one of yours. He's one of mine now. He's better paid and less happy. Does that trouble you? It should trouble one of us.

rules.rule: Never take from someone who'll have nothing left
rules.broken: {holding}. One rod, one boat, one Pokémon. You took it. I've sent it back with a card. The card has your name on it. You're welcome.

first.opens: "You've a district. I've six. You'll want to know whether I mind."
first.mess: "I don't mind competition. I mind mess. You leaned on {holding} on my side of the river. It was untidy. {who}'s mother's ill."
first.warm: "I don't mind competition. I mind mess. You haven't made any. I looked."
first.book: "It's in my ledger. Everything's in my ledger. Is it in yours?"
answers: "Good. Then we understand each other. A firm that doesn't know who it's taking from's a gang." A Truce is offered.
"You'll stay your side until you're large enough not to. I did. I'd rather you told me so now than in six weeks." A Truce is offered, with a shorter line. He's noted the answer.
He's not offended. "Then you'll have to be better at it than I am. I've rules. Four of them. Have you rules?" War. And he sends the fruit basket anyway, monthly, till it's over.

He takes a book from his jacket. It's small. He reads. "'Arrived the ninth. One van. The Boss went to the lighthouse the first night and looked at the sea for an hour.' Was it an hour?" Opinion: up. He likes being asked a real question.
first.offer: "A tenth. Paid on Fridays. You'll find I'm fair."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day. Your name off your own door.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2. His lawyers. His fences. Applicants from his waiting list.

Say no. He's fair about that, too.

"No. Fair." He doesn't look disappointed. He doesn't look anything.

second.stands: He stands up. It's the only time. "Sit. No: I'll sit when you have."
second.kept: "Four rules. You've kept the three I'd have checked. I didn't expect that."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."

Giovanni: "That isn't in anybody's ledger."
You: "No. He's in Johto. Red hair. He thinks strength's the only thing because he watched you lose it."
Giovanni: "...I haven't lost yet."
You: "You will. There's a child on the road with three Badges. You know there is."
Giovanni: "Yes." A pause. "What would you do. With six weeks."
choices: I don't know. I haven't got one.
said: He does. It isn't shown.
"No. But I'll stop after."
"No. You've {crew}." He looks at the second chair. Stance: Understanding. It's on the Ledger and not on the Board. Nobody on either Roster knows why the border's gone quiet.
son.stop: When the Hero beat him at Viridian he disbanded Rocket in the room, and added one sentence: "Somebody told me six weeks ago. I needed to lose first. I'm sorry it had to be you who showed me; you seem a decent child."

admins.name: Proton

said: Nothing. It goes on the Mess wall. Somebody straightens it.
Sent back. Opinion: down a step. No reply. None was required.
A reply, though none was required. Opinion: up a step. He answers, three lines straight, every district.
There's nothing in it. Good paper. A very careful hand. "He's practised that."
basket.war: Another letter, at War, three lines straight. "We are not presently in a position to contest it. — Archer, Interim."
basket.chair: The last letter. "It was never mine. — Archer." He's left off the Interim.

One of yours came to us. You'd missed his pay. We've no money to pay him either. He stayed anyway. That's the difference.

rules.broken: {holding}. You took the last of it. That was one of his rules. I keep them. Somebody has to.

first.opens: "Forgive me. I have to ask. I'd not forgive myself. ...Is it you?" You: "Is what me?" "No. No, of course. You'd be taller. I beg your pardon."
first.mess: "You leaned on {holding}. It was untidy. {who}'s known the street forty years. He'd have known that."
first.warm: "You haven't made a mess. I looked. He'd have looked."
first.book: "We've time on our hands. We watch. We used to keep a ledger. I still do. It's his format."
answers: He tells it. All of it. Three years. It's too long, and the second chair shifts in their seat. A Truce is offered.
He goes very still. "Is he well?" Whatever you tell him, he says: "That's his hand. ...He wrote all that down about you, and he never wrote to us." A Truce is offered.
"The broadcast's all we've got. If he's anywhere, he's somewhere with a radio." He won't trade the Tower. War, then, and he's sorry about it.
"I know." First time he's said it aloud. Petrel, behind the vending machine in a caretaker's coat, drops a mop. Opinion: up.
first.offer: "We are not presently in a position to contest anything. A line on the Board, and the Tower left to us. Or you could wear our colour. He'd have asked a tenth."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day. Your name off your own door.

"No. I understand." He opens the lemonade, at last.

second.kept: "His rules. You've kept the three I'd have checked. I don't think he'd have expected that."

The smile stays. "Our king. You'll like him." Terms are offered, faster than he'd meant.
"In front of your own people. How brave." War, declared by him, at once, politely.
He opens his mouth. "Mine. Ours. The king's." Three answers. He's never been asked. Opinion: up.
first.offer: "Stand behind me while I speak. I'll be the voice; you'll be the hands. A tenth to the Sages, for the cause."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day, to the Sages. Your say: he speaks for both teams, in every square.
You. And every trainer who hears him.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2: nothing he does is against any law. His squares, Warm on the day.
Say no. In private, he smiles. In the Hall, in front of the Roster, he declares War, politely.
frontSaid: "Splendid." The team's holdings wear Plasma's colour as a stripe. On Sunday he speaks for both.
"Of course." He smiles. He'll remember who was watching.
first.ask: "One question; I'll be quoting the answer. Why are you doing this? Not the Creed: I've improved that already. The reason."
first.wrote: He doesn't write it down. He'll say it in a square on Sunday, improved, and it'll still be yours.

second.opens: "Your Hall again. Good. They remember me."
second.stands: He stands, on the cane, and makes sure everyone sees it cost him. "Sit. I'd rather they watched you do it."
second.kept: "You've kept your word, your wages and your streets. I'd prepared something to say if you hadn't. I'll use it elsewhere."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."
cause: "Because the people who run this region won't fix it."
"Somebody has to be the one who's wrong out loud."
power: "Because I'm tired of asking."
"To find out how far it goes."
wonder: "There's something out there nobody's allowed to see. I want to see it."
"Because the old stories were true, and nobody's looking."
belonging: "Because these sixteen haven't got anybody else."
"Because nobody ever picked us. So we picked each other."
spite: "Because somebody once told me I wouldn't."
"So they'll have to look at me."

pen.laughs: "Pen? They're the Released. We freed them."
pen.goOn: "Sixty-eight. The king asked every one. Go on."
pen.empty: He's quiet. "You've never kept one. How very inconvenient." The king opens the doors for forty: the ones that asked to go home. "The rest chose to stay. I never told him they could."

lines: Ghetsis: "Our king. You'll like him. Everyone does. It's the only thing he's for."
That week, on the wheel in Nimbasa, the boy gets in your car. He doesn't sit.
N: "What's your team for? Your Pokémon say you don't know."
He waits. The car's at the top. He's listening to them, not to you.
choices: Tell him what the Creed says.
Tell him to stop listening to his father.
said: He listens to the Pokémon while you talk. He doesn't say which of you he believed.
"He isn't my— he's..." He stops. He's heard himself. What he does with it isn't shown.
"...Nor do I." The car comes round to the bottom. Neither of you gets out for another turn. Stance: Understanding. It's on the Ledger and not on the Board.
son.stop: In the castle, N already half knew. He stood beside the Hero for the last exchange and asked his father to say it in front of a Pokémon.

table.line: "I don't draw lines. I'll respect yours." He won't. It's written down as a Truce.
table.person: Handed over. He thanks them warmly, in front of everyone. They're in a square by Sunday.
table.minor: Minors are never on the table. The slot refuses them.
table.job: "The skull? Of course. Not this week." It can wait for a better audience. The reach is called off; the big job comes two days late.
table.money: "A tenth. For the Sages' fund." Opinion: up a step.
table.fact: Where the Hero is. "Thank you. I'll tell the king. He'll want to meet them."
table.promise: "Neither of us touches the child." "Agreed," he says, first and warmly. Every one of them agrees.

sitDown.rise: He leaves first, on the cane. The Triad are gone before the door shuts.
sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table.

asks.job: Stand at the back of his speech in Accumula, in your colours, and clap when he pauses.
asks.from: Every trainer in the square who's still deciding.
asks.why: It's the speech. They count who clapped.

asks.job: Leave the Nacrene Museum's back door open on day 3, and be somewhere else.
asks.from: Hawes, and Lenora's museum.
asks.why: It's the skull. The Hero's coming to Nacrene for it.

asks.job: Collect a trainer's Pokémon, for its own good, and take it to the cold store.
asks.from: A family in Driftveil it was Warm with.
asks.why: "Released" is his word. Every Kind on the Roster refuses.

askSaid.did: Done. It's on the Ledger under the team's name. The Card for it had "The other way" filled in, and you read it.
askSaid.no: "How disappointing." Said politely, in front of your door Grunt. The Front ends. Rivals.

chair.says: "And when you lose, you'll kneel. I do like to be clear."
chair.won: Ghetsis is beaten, in front of both Rosters. N won't fight for a chair, and he isn't in the room. Plasma is the team's.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's Plasma's: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: Ghetsis fell to the Hero, in his own castle. The team's its own again, smaller, with his Grunts asking what happens now.

betrayal.grabs: The king. The dragon. The speech. He's the Boss and he's the Betrayal: it's N who's betrayed.
betrayal.says: "Did you think I raised him to be listened to?"

fall.boss: Ghetsis never serves and never leaves quietly. He tries the Betrayal on the spot, and the Triad carry him off like luggage, still talking.

admins.name: Colress
admins.says: Joins anyone with an interesting problem. Eyes. His flaw field reads "Curious," and he'll tell the Boss exactly what the Shadow Lab does, with a chart.

admins.name: Zinzolin
admins.says: The Sages scatter. He comes as an Officer: Voice, Proud. First question: has the base got a cold store?

admins.name: Rood
admins.says: Stays in Driftveil and looks after the Released nobody came for. The team can fund it: a Work.

admins.name: The Shadow Triad
admins.says: Loyal to Ghetsis. They carry him off and never speak first. Their cards have no line at all.

admins.name: Anthea and Concordia
admins.says: Ask one thing: N's old room. They'd like to pack it. A Heart goes. It's a playroom with a train set in it.

fall.gruntsSaid: Twenty-four want to stay: the ones who meant it. {beds} take a bed. The rest wait at the Town. They won't use a Poké Ball.
fall.holdings: Plasma's squares are the team's, at mood Wary. "Is it the same rent?" There's never been rent on a fountain.

pen.clean: Clean hands: the doors are opened that night and the game doesn't ask.
pen.choice: The Released are the team's to decide. He called them freed.
said: The doors are opened that night. Forty go home. The rest stay, and Rood takes them in.
Kept. It's on the Ledger.

scheme.name: The only trainer left
scheme.other: Don't. It was never a good idea.

fall.hero: The Hero's reason was about Plasma. That evening it's rewritten in their own hand: it's about you now.

vault.title: A LEGEND IN THE VAULT
card: Nobody. The sky, and a stone that stayed warm.
The strongest Pokémon this team'll ever field.
Dread +3. Heat +4, and its floor's now 5. Every Kind Grunt's Loyalty −1.
Will hear by tomorrow. This is the day the Hero stops thinking the team's small.
Whether it wants to be here.
Open the ball. Regard +3. It goes. It looks at the Boss first.
vault.freed: Opened the ball. It looked at the Boss first, and went. The sky's clear by morning; locals are one warmer. N sends one line, from a long way up: "It told me you let it choose. I've stopped being surprised by you."

neighbours.ground: His café. The corner table. He pulls out the chair.
neighbours.refuses: Nothing. He'll come anywhere. He'll admire the curtains.
neighbours.does: He gave. For twenty years, with both hands, to anyone who asked. Every Work on the team's Ledger is one he did first, bigger, and stopped believing in.

ticks.name: The first move
ticks.text: The fossil cave. Two Grunts, very well dressed, being unpleasant to an assistant.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: two men in red suits in the Glittering Cave, and an assistant who says they were ever so rude.

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: The power plant. Lumiose goes dark by quarters.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the power plant's been taken, very politely, and Lumiose is going dark a quarter at a time. Flare's Dread +2.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: The Poké Ball factory. Every Ball in Kalos.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the Ball factory's in red suits, and so are two more doors on Laverre's streets. The shops have no Balls.

ticks.name: The Legend
ticks.text: The stones on Route 10; Geosenge; the weapon opens like a flower.
ticks.radio: Something's come up out of the ground at Geosenge, and it's opened. Every holding's one mood colder for a day. Every Pokémon in the building faces south.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: The room with the buttons. He fires it, or the Hero stops him, or the switch does.
ticks.radio: The Hero and four friends reached the room under Geosenge. Flare's red comes off the Board, holding by holding, over an evening.

basket.text: An invitation. Card stock, cream, hand-lettered: "Dinner. Thursday. The corner table. — L." No address. Everyone in Lumiose knows which corner.
said: Nothing. It goes on the Mess mantelpiece. Somebody dusts round it.
Regrets sent. Opinion: down a step. A second card comes back: "Another time. — L."
An acceptance, on the best paper the team owns. Opinion: up a step. He writes back every district, in the same hand.
There's nothing in it. Good card, real ink. Lucienne, if she's on the Roster: "He'll ask if you think the world's beautiful. There isn't a right answer."
basket.war: Another invitation, at War. The same table. "— L."
basket.chair: The last card. "Thank you for dinner. — L." He's crossed out the Thursday.

rules.rule: Never be rude to the people who serve you
rules.broken: You leaned on {holding}. {who} pours the best coffee in the quarter. One doesn't. I'd hoped you didn't.
One of yours waited on me. He's not been paid. I tipped him a month's wages. I hope that wasn't rude.
{holding}. You took it and paid nothing. My people pay full price, and tip. It's the least of what we owe.

first.opens: "I've a list." He says it the way someone else'd say they've a boat. "It costs five million to be on it. I'm waiving yours."
first.mess: "And you leaned on {holding}. {who} pours the best coffee in the quarter. That was rude, and I'd hoped you weren't."
first.warm: "I had someone read your Ledger. You've done good work here. I'd have done it, once. How did it feel? I've forgotten, and I'd like to know whether it's the same."
first.book: "I had someone read your Ledger. How many are on your payroll? Sixteen. And if I told you there was room for twelve? No, don't answer. I only wanted to watch you try to."
answers: "Yes. You would." He writes sixteen names. He knows them; he's had someone find out. A place is offered.
He shows it. Four hundred names, and one you know: the baker in Camphrier, who paid five million she didn't have. A place is offered.
A long look. "You're the first who's asked. People beg to be on." One line through, with a fountain pen. Opinion: from magnificent to a pity.
He puts his glass down. "...Nobody needed to. I was the one with enough." It's the nearest he comes. Opinion: up.
first.offer: "A place. For you, and for up to twenty named others. It's a gift."
frontCard: A place. For the Boss, and for up to twenty named others.
Nothing, yet. Every Kind on the Roster, on learning what the list is: Loyalty −3.
A place where. A place when. What happens to people who aren't on it.
Ask him what it's a list of.
frontChoices: Ask what it's a list of
frontSaid: "I'm so glad." The team's holdings wear Flare's red as a thread in the hem.
"The ones who'll be left. It'll be so much quieter. I've done the sums a great many times and they do come out. I'd hoped they wouldn't."
first.ask: "One more, and then dessert. Do you think the world's beautiful? ...Then why are you doing this? Not the creed on the wall. I had one of those. The reason."
first.wrote: He writes it on the back of the menu, with a fountain pen. He keeps the menu.

second.opens: "You came. Sit. I've ordered for you; I remembered."
second.stands: He stands and pulls out the chair. "Please. I insist. I always insist."
second.kept: "You've paid your people and been civil to the waiters. I had someone check. It's rarer than you'd think."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."
cause: "Because the people who run this region won't fix it."
"Somebody has to be the one who's wrong out loud."
power: "Because I'm tired of asking."
"To find out how far it goes."
wonder: "There's something out there nobody's allowed to see. I want to see it."
"Because the old stories were true, and nobody's looking."
belonging: "Because these sixteen haven't got anybody else."
"Because nobody ever picked us. So we picked each other."
spite: "Because somebody once told me I wouldn't."
"So they'll have to look at me."

pen.laughs: "Pen? I've a power plant. They came with it."
pen.goOn: "Ten. From the plant. They keep the lights off. Go on."
pen.empty: He's quiet. "You've never kept one." He turns his glass. "They're not mine to open. They're the weapon's, now. I'm sorry."

lines: Lysandre: "Your Work. No cover. No return. I had it looked into; I was sure there'd be an angle. There wasn't."
Lysandre: "Did they thank you?"
said: "And was it enough? ...It was, wasn't it. It was for me, too, the first hundred times." He pays the bill.
"No. They don't. And you did it anyway, and you'd do the next one. Why? I'm asking as a man who stopped." He pays the bill.
He watches you eat for a moment. Very quietly: "I used to be able to do that." He pays the bill. Under Geosenge, there's a chair facing the buttons, pulled out.
son.stop: When the Hero reached the room under Geosenge, there was a chair facing the buttons, pulled out. Nobody had sat in it.

table.line: A line on the Board, drawn on the tablecloth in fountain pen. Neither crosses. Truce.
table.person: Handed over. He has them driven home, and sends flowers after.
table.minor: Minors are never on the table. The slot refuses them.
table.job: "The plant. ...For you, a little while. Not long." The lights stay on a week; the factory comes two days late.
table.jobNo: "No. Forgive me. It's larger than a district."
table.money: "How generous. I'll give it to a hospital." Opinion: up a step.
table.fact: Where the Hero is. "With four friends. They always are. Thank you."
table.promise: "Neither of us touches the child." "Agreed." Every one of them agrees.

sitDown.rise: He pays the bill. He always pays the bill.
sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table.

asks.job: Carry a case from the Glittering Cave to Lumiose. Don't open it.
asks.from: Professor Sycamore's assistant.
asks.why: It's the fossil. Two very well dressed Grunts were too rude to carry it themselves.

asks.job: Lend six Grunts for the Poké Ball factory.
asks.from: Ms. Thandiwe Laurent and her staff, held a day.
asks.why: It's the big job. The team's uniforms are at the factory gate when the Hero walks up.

asks.job: Move the stones on Route 10.
asks.from: Everybody in Kalos not on the list.
asks.why: It's the weapon. Every Kind on the Roster refuses.

askSaid.did: Done. It's on the Ledger under the team's name. The Card for it had "The other way" filled in, and you read it.
askSaid.no: "I'm disappointed. I'll survive it. So, it seems, will you." The Front ends. Rivals.

chair.says: "If you win, you'll have my people. Be kinder to them than I was going to be."
chair.won: Lysandre's beaten, in front of both Rosters. He straightens his cuffs and shakes hands. Flare is the team's.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's Flare's: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district, always politely.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: Lysandre fell to the Hero. The team's its own again, smaller, with his Grunts asking for their five million back.

betrayal.says: "The chief's finished? Then it's a free experiment."

fall.boss: Lysandre asks for the list back. First he asks the Boss to read it aloud, all four hundred names; then he burns it in the café's grate. After, he waits tables in Lucienne's old section. He's bad at it, and he's there every day.

admins.name: Xerosic
admins.says: The Betrayal. After: "Could I keep the suit?" He asks if the Workshop's got a vacancy. It hasn't. Faye's rule.

admins.name: Aliana
admins.says: Joins with the other three, all or none, as a standing squad. Argues about its name.

admins.name: Bryony
admins.says: Joins with the other three. Thinks the squad's name is beneath her, and says so.

admins.name: Celosia
admins.says: Joins with the other three. Wants the Boss's notice, and keeps count of who's had it.

admins.name: Mable
admins.says: Joins with the other three. Complains about the squad's name the longest.

admins.name: Malva
admins.says: Stays on television. Reads the team's Heat on the evening news, one higher than it is.

fall.gruntsSaid: Eighteen want to stay. {beds} take a bed. The rest wait at the Town. All of them would like their five million back.
fall.holdings: Flare's holdings are the team's, at mood Wary. "Is it the same rent? We paid five million for the last one."

pen.clean: Clean hands: the doors are opened that night and the game doesn't ask.
pen.choice: Flare's Pen is the team's to decide. He said they came with the plant.
said: The doors are opened that night. Ten, back to the wires and the woods.
Kept. It's on the Ledger.

scheme.name: A quieter world
scheme.other: Don't. It was never a good idea.

fall.hero: The Hero's reason was about Flare. That evening it's rewritten in their own hand: it's about you now.

vault.title: A LEGEND IN THE VAULT
card: The strongest Pokémon this team'll ever field.
Dread +3. Heat +4, and its floor's now 5. Every Kind Grunt's Loyalty −1.
Will hear by tomorrow. This is the day the Hero stops thinking the team's small.
Whether it wants to be here. What it took, to give what it gives.
Open the ball. Regard +3. It goes. It looks at the Boss first.
vault.freed: Opened the ball. It looked at the Boss first, and went. The trees on Route 10 are green by morning; locals are one warmer. Lysandre sends one line, on cream card: "You had life itself in your hand, and you let it go. I'd have kept it for the four hundred."

neighbours.ground: The team's front door. In the rain.
neighbours.refuses: A café. "I ain't sittin' in no café."
neighbours.does: Nobody's turned away. Skull's door question's "You got anywhere else?" and the answer's always no. The team's Roster has a cap. Theirs hasn't.

ticks.name: The first move
ticks.text: Skull make a nuisance at a Trial site. Ilima's amused.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: kids in skull caps rapping outside Verdant Cavern. Ilima says they've got rhythm, at least.

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: They take the children's house's Yungoos; they take a berry farmer's crop.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: Mr. Tago's berries are gone, the lot, and the little ones at Aether House are missing a Yungoos. Skull's Dread +2.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: Aether's paradise: a floor below the conservation deck. A girl who's run away with something in a bag.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: a girl's missing from Aether Paradise. The Foundation says she's visiting family. Nobody's seen a boat.

ticks.name: The Legend
ticks.text: The hole in the sky. Lusamine goes through, and takes Guzma.
ticks.radio: The sky over Poni's got a hole in it this morning. Every holding's one mood colder for a day. Skull's Grunts are sitting on the kerb in Po Town, waiting.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: The Hero, the altar, the sky.
ticks.radio: The Hero came down from the altar. Skull's grey comes off the Board, holding by holding, over an evening. Somebody's left a hat on a bus stop.

basket.text: He turns up. In person. In the rain. He's disappointed the base has a roof. "YO. This your place? It's dry. Who's got a dry base."
choices: Tell him to get off the step
said: He looks past you, at the Mess. "...You feed 'em in there?" "Every night." "Huh. Plumes does that." A pause. "What's your name." Next morning, by text: "big g says its on. also he says ur soup smelled good."
He goes. War's declared in person, properly, and he means it a bit more. Opinion: down a step.
He doesn't come in. He stands in the doorway with his back to the room and asks how the rota works. Opinion: up a step.
He eats standing up, in the rain, and won't say thank you. Plumeria texts it for him the next day. Opinion: up a step.
basket.war: A text, at War: "big g says ur still on. also ur bins r out."
basket.chair: The last text: "guzma says ur the boss now. plumes says be nice to the little ones."

rules.broken: You turned somebody off your step at {holding}. That's the one thing we don't do. — P.
One of yours took a Pokémon and didn't feed it. One of mine did. — P.
{holding}. One of ours is twelve. Remember that next time. — P.

first.opens: It's his room in the Shady House. It rains through the ceiling into a bucket. "Sit wherever. Not there, that's wet."
first.mess: "You leaned on {holding}. {who}'s one of Plumes's. She's furious. I'm furious. Mostly she is."
first.warm: "Plumes says you pay your people on the day. Every one. Even the useless ones. How'd you do that."
first.book: "Plumes keeps a book. On everybody. What d'you want, man. We ain't got nothin'."
choices: A line, and you keep to it.
Who told you you weren't strong?
answers: He draws it on the wall in marker. It's very wonky. A Truce is offered.
He looks at the floor. "...Plumes already gave it back. Don't tell anybody." A Truce is offered.
"FINE." War, by text, the next morning. He's not angry. He's relieved somebody's paying attention.
He stops. For a long time. "...Nobody told me I was. That's the thing." Opinion: up.
first.offer: (Plumeria, from the door.) "A line on the map. Or wear our gear and kick in a tenth. We'd spend it on food. Honest."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day. Your name off your own door.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2. Skull's spray paint on the door. Forty kids who think you're cool.
frontSaid: "YO." The team's holdings get a skull sprayed on, small, in the corner, where it can be painted over.
"Whatever. Respect." He means the second word.
first.ask: "One more. Plumes said ask it. Why d'you do it? The whole thing. The coats."
first.wrote: Plumeria writes it in her book. She shows it to him. He reads it twice.

second.stands: He stands. He doesn't know what to do with his hands. He puts them in his pockets.
second.kept: "Plumes says you kept your word. She checked. She always checks."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."
cause: "Because the people who run this region won't fix it."
"Somebody has to be the one who's wrong out loud."
power: "Because I'm tired of asking."
"To find out how far it goes."
wonder: "There's something out there nobody's allowed to see. I want to see it."
"Because the old stories were true, and nobody's looking."
belonging: "Because these sixteen haven't got anybody else."
"Because nobody ever picked us. So we picked each other."
spite: "Because somebody once told me I wouldn't."
"So they'll have to look at me."

pen.laughs: "Pen? It's a shed. Half of 'em are just there 'cause it's dry."
pen.goOn: "Six. Somebody feeds 'em. Not me. Go on."
pen.empty: "...You never took any? Huh." He goes and opens the shed himself. Nobody leaves. It's dry.

lines: Guzma: "You built a thing. For nothin'. Plumes cried. She don't cry."
Guzma: "Did anybody say you did all right?"
said: "Huh. Must be nice." He means it. He isn't being rude.
"Yeah. Nobody does. You do it anyway." He looks at the bucket. "...Huh."
He takes it. He eats it standing up. Very quietly: "...Thanks." It's the first time anyone's heard him say it.
son.stop: When Lusamine came for him, he was at the base's door first, to say he was going. He wanted to be told not to.

table.line: A line on the Board, in marker, on the Shady House wall. Neither crosses. Truce.
table.person: Handed over. Plumeria walks them home herself.
table.minor: Minors are never on the table. The slot refuses them. (Plumeria: "Good.")
table.job: "The Yungoos thing? ...Yeah, all right. Plumes wanted to anyway." The Yungoos goes home; tick 2 comes two days late.
table.jobNo: "Nah. That's Aether's money. I don't touch that."
table.money: "For real?" He gives it to Plumeria. It's food by tonight. Opinion: up a step.
table.fact: Where the Hero is. "With Hau. They're always with Hau."
table.promise: "Neither of us touches the kid." "Agreed." Every one of them agrees.

sitDown.rise: He leaves first. He forgets his hat.
sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table.

asks.job: Stand outside Verdant Cavern and look scary for an afternoon.
asks.from: Ilima, who's mildly inconvenienced.
asks.why: It's the nuisance. It's all they've got.

asks.job: Carry a sack of berries from Route 2 to Po Town.
asks.from: Mr. Ezekiel Tago, whose crop it is.
asks.why: It's the crop. He taught Keoni to swim.

asks.job: Stand on the quay at the bridge and don't notice anything.
asks.from: A girl with a bag, and whatever's in it.
asks.why: It's Aether's job, through Skull. Every Kind on the Roster refuses.

askSaid.did: Done. It's on the Ledger under the team's name. The Card for it had "The other way" filled in, and you read it.
askSaid.no: "Whatever, man." The gear's off. Rivals. He texts anyway.

chair.says: "If you win, you get the kids. All of 'em. They eat a lot."
chair.won: Guzma's beaten, in front of both Rosters. He sits on the floor. "...Yeah. Yeah, okay." Skull is the team's.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's Skull's: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district, by text, spelt badly.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: Guzma fell to the Hero. The team's its own again, with forty kids asking if there's soup.

betrayal.grabs: Guzma, through the hole in the sky.
betrayal.says: "You're the strongest I've ever seen. There's something through there only you can beat."

fall.boss: Guzma asks to be a Grunt. "I never did the bit at the bottom. Went straight to boss. Maybe that's what's wrong with it." He's the Grunt who gets told he did all right.

admins.name: Plumeria

admins.name: Guzma
admins.says: Asks to be a Grunt. The first time the Boss says he did all right, he pretends he didn't hear and asks to hear it again.

fall.holdings: Skull's bus stops are the team's, at mood Wary. Somebody's painted over the skulls. Badly.

ticks.text: Yell block a road. Mags Dunmore knows them by name.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: Route 4's blocked by young people in face paint. Mags Dunmore says hello to Daz, Kev and Little Kev.

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: A mural's knocked down at Stow-on-Side by a boy who wants the Chairman's notice.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the mural at Stow-on-Side's come down. A boy with a Copperajah says it was for the Chairman. Yell's chanting about it, badly.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: The lights in Hammerlocke flicker. Raihan's stadium roof glows red at night.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the lights in Hammerlocke went off twice last night. Macro Cosmos says it's in hand.

ticks.name: The Legend
ticks.text: The Darkest Day. The Chairman wakes the thing under Hammerlocke a day before the final.
ticks.radio: Every screen in Galar's showing the Chairman saying it's in hand. Every holding's one mood colder for a day. Wild Pokémon are the size of houses.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: The Hero, two wolves, a rusted sword.
ticks.radio: The Hero came down the tower. Yell go home when Marnie tells them to. The pink comes off the Board, road by road, over an evening.

said: He rings off cheerfully. He'll ring again.
"Oh. Are you sure? It's a very good mug." He's hurt. He rings again next district as if it hadn't happened. Opinion: down a step.
"Splendid!" A brochure comes by van. Opinion: up a step.
A silence on the line. "...I beg your pardon?" He rings off. He doesn't ring again for a week.
basket.war: A chant from across the road, at War. It rhymes badly. Nobody's sure it's about you.
basket.chair: The last chant. It's for Marnie. It's always been for Marnie.

rules.broken: You didn't turn up for {holding}. We did. We always do.
One of yours took something at {holding}. We've never taken a Pokémon. Never.

first.opens: It's Piers, at the back of the Spikemuth hall, coiling a lead. "They're not mine, y'know. Everyone thinks I run 'em."
first.mess: "You leaned on {holding}. {who}'s Marnie's neighbour. She'll hear. She hears everything."
first.warm: "You've got an outfit. Proper one. Rotas an' that. I've heard."
first.book: "Spikemuth's small. Everything gets here eventually. What d'you want? We've got nothing. That's the whole trouble."
choices: A line, and you keep to it.
Nothing. Keep them off my roads.
Do you ever look at them and think you're the reason?
answers: He nods. "They'll keep to it. Mostly." A Truce is offered.
He looks up. "...Yeah. That." A Truce is offered.
He shrugs. "Your funeral, mate." War, which means a lot of horns.
"Every day." He nods for a while. "Good. Means you're still lookin'." Opinion: up.
first.offer: "A line on the map. Or wear the pink and shout for her. They'd like that. Costs a tenth. Goes on the shutter fund."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day, to the shutter fund.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2. Face paint. Forty people who turn up.
Whether Marnie wants any of it.
frontSaid: The team's holdings get pink ribbons on the railings. Somebody brings a horn.
"Fair enough." He goes back to coiling the lead.
first.ask: "One more. Why? The whole outfit. I'm askin' for a friend. The friend's me."
first.wrote: He writes it on the back of a set list.

second.opens: "You came back. Spikemuth doesn't get repeat visitors."
second.stands: He stands. He's taller than you thought.
second.kept: "You kept to it. They noticed. They chanted about it. Sorry."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."
cause: "Because the people who run this region won't fix it."

power: "Because I'm tired of asking."

wonder: "There's something out there nobody's allowed to see. I want to see it."
"Because the old stories were true, and nobody's looking."
belonging: "Because these sixteen haven't got anybody else."
"Because nobody ever picked us. So we picked each other."
spite: "Because somebody once told me I wouldn't."
"So they'll have to look at me."

pen.laughs: "Pen? We've never taken a Pokémon. Not one."

lines: Piers: "You opened something. For nothin'. Marnie told me."
Piers: "Did anyone thank you?"
said: "Good." He hums something. It's the start of a song.
"No. They don't. Wrote a song about that once."
He nods. He doesn't push. Under the stage, there's a set list with your name on it, crossed out, then written in again.
son.stop: On the Darkest Day, Yell stood at the bottom of the tower and didn't shout. Forty people, not shouting.

table.person: Handed over. They walk them home, chanting.
table.minor: Minors are never on the table. The slot refuses them.
table.job: "The mural? ...Yeah. We'll stand in front of it." The mural stands two days longer.
table.money: "Shutter fund." He puts it in a guitar case. Opinion: up a step.
table.fact: Where the Hero is. "Wherever Marnie is, near enough."
table.promise: "Neither of us touches the kid." "Agreed." Every one of them agrees.

sitDown.rise: He leaves first. He's got a gig.
sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table. There's nothing else.

asks.from: Everybody trying to get to Turffield.
asks.why: It's the road block. Mags Dunmore will tell you all off.

asks.job: Stand in front of the mural at Stow-on-Side.
asks.from: A boy with a Copperajah and a sponsor's orders.
asks.why: It's the mural. Opal's district; Allister's ghosts like it.

asks.job: Carry a crate to the gantries under Hammerlocke. Don't open it.
asks.from: Whoever's under the castle.
asks.why: It's the plant. Every Kind on the Roster refuses.

askSaid.no: "Fair enough." The pink's off. Rivals. They chant anyway.

chair.won: Piers is beaten, in front of both Rosters. "Yeah. Figures." Yell is the team's. They chant about it.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's Yell's: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district: turn up.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: The Chairman fell to the Hero. Yell went home when Marnie told them to.

betrayal.says: "I'm going to do it anyway. I'm so sorry."

admins.name: Marnie

neighbours.does: They stood up for each other when no adult would. Every one of them's kept a promise for eighteen months that nobody made them make.

3.says: "You've got HOW many Grunts? And you came yourself? ...The stew's not ready. Sit. Taste it. Tell me it's good or don't say anything."

4.says: "Hold this end. No: higher. ...It's a banner. It's got everyone's names on it. Don't read them out."

5.says: "You're an ADULT. With a VAN. ...Can you get a part? Nobody'll sell us one. I could buy the shop. That's not the point."

ticks.text: Cassiopeia rings the Hero. She wants Team Star ended, gently: each base challenged, each crew boss beaten, a promise let go.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the Academy's asked pupils to stay away from Team Star's bases. Nobody at the Academy now knows why they're there.

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: The Hero takes Giacomo's base, and Mela's.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: two Star bases have their flags down. A crew boss is sitting on the step of one, by himself.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: The Hero takes Atticus's base. The banner's half-finished.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: a third Star base has its flag down. Somebody's left a reel of purple thread on the gate.

ticks.name: The Legend
ticks.text: The Hero takes Ortega's base. Their Legend's eating the Hero's sandwiches.
ticks.radio: The Hero's been seen with something very large that's somebody's. Every holding's one mood colder for a day: it's raining in the open country.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: The Hero takes Eri's base, and then Cassiopeia's. The promise is let go.
ticks.radio: The last Star flag came down. Nobody fell: they were let go of a promise. Star's purple comes off the Board, base by base, over an evening.

said: "...Good." She wasn't expecting that. Opinion: up a step.
The voice changer clicks off for half a second. A girl's voice: "What?" It clicks on. "That's not— why would you ask that." She rings off. Opinion: unchanged.
"From you?" A pause. "...Mela's crew haven't got a decent cooking pot. Forget I said that." Opinion: up a step.
She waits. You wait. She rings off first. Opinion: down a step.
